response.sql:
WITH combination_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ab.translink,
    tr.ordertypedist,
    COUNT(*) AS matched_record_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  WHERE ab.peercorr > 0.149
    AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist
),
with_fractions AS (
  SELECT
    translink,
    ordertypedist,
    matched_record_count,
    1.0 * matched_record_count
      / SUM(matched_record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS fraction_of_order_type_total
  FROM combination_counts
)
SELECT
  translink,
  ordertypedist,
  matched_record_count,
  fraction_of_order_type_total
FROM with_fractions
ORDER BY fraction_of_order_type_total DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Each advancedbehavior row with a matching transaction record counts as one matched record; the fraction denominator includes all grouped combinations for the same order type mix after filtering out missing mixes.
